cues.en: Alright, we've been talking about RBM's for long enough.
cues.zh: RBM 談得夠久了。

cues.en: Let's actually run the thing and see how it does.
cues.zh: 真正執行，看看表現。

cues.en: Select the RBMBakeOff.py file, and take a quick look at it.
cues.zh: 選 RBMBakeOff.py，快速看看。

cues.en: There's not a lot to talk about, what we're doing is pitting our RBM algorithm with 20 epochs and default hyperparameters against random recommendations.
cues.zh: 沒太多說明，就是讓 20 個訓練週期、預設超參數的 RBM，與隨機推薦比較。

cues.en: Hit the play button, and go get a cup of coffee, catch up on your messages, whatever you need to do.
cues.zh: 按播放，去喝咖啡、看訊息，做需要做的事。

cues.en: We did pass true to the Evaluate function, so we're going to run all of the top-N metrics on everything which can take quite a bit of time, so pause this video, and resume when
cues.zh: Evaluate 傳入 True，因此會執行所有 Top-N 指標，可能很耗時。先暫停影片，等

cues.en: you're ready to review the results with me.
cues.zh: 準備好與我一起看結果，再繼續。

cues.en: OK, there's a lot to digest here.
cues.zh: 好，有很多要消化。

cues.en: Let's start by looking at the table of all the metrics.
cues.zh: 先看所有指標的表格。

cues.en: The accuracy measures, RMSE and MAE, are better than random but they're not great.
cues.zh: RMSE 與 MAE 準確程度指標，比隨機好，但不算很棒。

cues.en: We mentioned before that the way we're computing predicted rating values tends to artificially lower them, the expectation values we end up with don't get any higher than four stars.
cues.zh: 前面說過，預測評分的計算方式，會人為壓低它們，最後期望值，不超過四顆星。

cues.en: Accuracy is the promised strength of RBM's though.
cues.zh: 但準確程度，是 RBM 承諾的優點。

cues.en: In the paper, RMSE is the only way in which they evaluated their algorithms, and they managed to very slightly outperform SVD after tuning things sufficiently.
cues.zh: 論文只用 RMSE 評估，充分調整後，略微勝過 SVD。

cues.en: The hit rate metrics however are underwhelming.
cues.zh: 不過，命中率令人失望。

cues.en: We're dealing with small numbers here so it's hard to read too much into it, but even random recommendations did better with hit rate no matter how you measure it.
cues.zh: 數字很小，難以過度解讀，但不管哪種命中率，甚至隨機推薦都更好。

cues.en: That's disappointing, because even if there is a bias in our predicted rating scores, we would hope that rankings would still be meaningful.
cues.zh: 很失望，因為即使預測評分有偏差，也希望排序仍有意義。

cues.en: Don't read too much into the coverage metric.
cues.zh: 別過度解讀覆蓋率。

cues.en: It's based on a rating threshold of 4.0, and as we said our predicted ratings just don't get that high with this approach.
cues.zh: 根據 4.0 評分門檻，但如前所說，這種方法的預測，根本達不到那麼高。

cues.en: Interestingly, RBM produced results that were less diverse than random ones.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，RBM 結果，比隨機更少樣化。

cues.en: So, that might mean that it is picking up on coherent themes and recommending the same sorts of things to individual people, implying that it is doing something useful at least.
cues.zh: 可能表示，它找出了連貫主題，替各人推薦同類東西，至少做了有用的事。

cues.en: The higher novelty score however implies that it's digging fairly deep into the long tail of movies at times to produce recommendations.
cues.zh: 但較高新穎性，表示有時深入電影長尾產生推薦。

cues.en: These might be really insightful recommendations, or they could just as easily be spurious results.
cues.zh: 可能非常有洞察力，也可能只是錯誤結果。

cues.en: Hm, so not much payoff for all that work, so far, at least not quantitatively.
cues.zh: 嗯，至少到目前，量化上，這些工作沒多少回報。

cues.en: Let's take a subjective look at the results, and look at the top-N recommendations that came back for our favorite user, user 85.
cues.zh: 主觀看看，最愛的使用者 85，得到的 Top-N 推薦。

cues.en: These actually look like decent recommendations to me.
cues.zh: 我覺得其實不錯。

cues.en: Moon and Harry Potter are good results for a sci-fi and fantasy fan, and we have a couple of classic Japanese animation films there too.
cues.zh: 對科幻、奇幻迷，Moon 與 Harry Potter 都是好結果，也有幾部經典日本動畫。

cues.en: We've got a couple of popular action adventure titles in there too.
cues.zh: 也有幾部熱門動作冒險片。

cues.en: There are a few obscure foreign films sneaking in, which may be spurious, but the mix of recognizable films to obscure ones seems like a reasonable balance.
cues.zh: 混入一些冷門外國片，也許不相關，但熟悉與冷門影片比例，似乎合理。

cues.en: Overall, it seems like we might be on to something, but our results from our first cut at it aren't too exciting.
cues.zh: 整體似乎有進展，但第一次嘗試結果，沒那麼令人興奮。

cues.en: With machine learning though, it's easy to give up too soon.
cues.zh: 不過，機器學習很容易太早放棄。

cues.en: Often the issue doesn't lie in the algorithm, but in your choices of hyperparameters, or in the nature of the data you're using to test it with.
cues.zh: 問題往往不是演算法，而是超參數選擇，或測試資料性質。

cues.en: Maybe 100,000 ratings is just too small of a data set to train an RBM, especially when we're doing Gibbs sampling to further cut down the data we're using to train it with.
cues.zh: 也許十萬筆評分，對 RBM 太少，尤其又用 Gibbs 取樣，進一步減少訓練資料。

cues.en: Maybe we should investigate using something other than softmax when converting the reconstructed visible layer in our RBM to probabilities for rating values, since it seemed to result in rating
cues.zh: 也許，重建可見層轉成評分機率時，應研究 softmax 以外的方法，因為它似乎讓所有

cues.en: predictions that were too low across the board.
cues.zh: 預測都太低。

cues.en: There's a lot to tweak and experiment with to see if you can squeeze more performance out of it.
cues.zh: 有很多東西可調、可實驗，看看能否榨出更多效能。

cues.en: You can probably guess what your next exercise is going to be then, let's talk about that next.
cues.zh: 你大概猜得到下一個練習，接著談。
